cohort: The cohort consisted of 17,044 patients with liveborn deliveries between 2018 and 2022 from a large, multihospital academic health system.
finding: In multivariable logistic regression, VBAC was not significantly associated with obstetric anal sphincter injury (OASI).
mod_finding: Operative vaginal delivery was significantly associated with increased odds of obstetric anal sphincter injury (OASI).
